omar-sales: Team — Acme wants a hosted API key for a 2-week POC. Requirements: inference-only, auto-rotate daily, IP allowlist (198.51.100.0/24), audit evidence for contract. What's the recommended ops flow?

jess-sec: Short answer: we don't issue public auto-rotate webhooks. For POCs we require scoped, short-lived keys and an approval ticket (jira:SEC-PROV). Security will approve the CIDR and owner, then either create the key or approve a customer-managed rotation integration.

liam-devex: Console self-serve is fastest: Settings -> API Keys -> Create -> name acme-poc-temp -> scopes: inference:generate -> expires 7d -> IP allowlist 198.51.100.0/24. For daily rotation provide them with our admin API sample (under NDA) and recommend they run a small scheduled job to call it.

eva-soleng: Admin API example (trimmed): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"name":"acme-poc-rot","scopes":["inference:generate"],"expires_in":86400,"ip_allowlist":["198.51.100.0/24"]}' Response includes id and key. Use POST /admin/keys/{id}/revoke to retire old keys. Share admin API only with SE and with restricted tokens.

liam-devex: Suggested pattern for auto-rotate: customer lambda (or secret manager hook) runs every 24h: 1) create new key via admin API 2) push secret into customer secret store 3) call revoke on old key id. We can provide a one-page script but we don't host the rotation runner for them unless contracted.

sre-bot: [automated] Audit event: api_key.created by eva-soleng id=key_xyz at 2025-02-03T10:12:05Z

omar-sales: Great — I'll add the SOW line: "Redwood will provide admin API details and a sample rotation script under NDA; customer to run rotation in their infra unless otherwise contracted." Opening jira:SEC-PROV now with CIDR and POC owner.

jess-sec: Security sign-off path noted. If they need signed audit exports for the contract, open a ticket and we can produce a CSV.

eva-soleng: Happy to attach the audit CSV. If they want us to operate rotation for the POC, scope a SE timeboxed task and we'll accept a limited admin token for the duration.

omar-sales: Thanks all, sending to Acme now.
